svg.title: Сгибание ноги стоя на нижнем блоке — положение 1
svg.desc: Original ImageGen hollow contour, vector traced. Standing single-leg low-cable hamstring curl, STRICT side view. Athlete faces a fixed cable tower to the LEFT. Hands brace the tower, one foot supports body on floor. The low pulley is on the tower at ankle height, directly in front of athlete. A taut thin cable runs from this low pulley to the cuff around the WORKING ankle. LEFT panel: working leg hangs almost straight beside stance leg, working foot a little above floor. RIGHT panel: working knee flexes to bring heel backward/up toward buttocks on the RIGHT side, working thigh stays near vertical alongside stance thigh; hips and torso stationary. Cable in right panel must visibly run from the SAME low pulley across the side of the stance leg to the elevated WORKING ankle cuff, not to hand or shoe of standing leg. No hip kick. Same pulley, same person and grounded foot in both phases. Expert biomechanics approval pending.
